player_prompt.intro:
Udlale Blackjack ngedealer.
Inhloso yakho kukuthola kule mpelasento 21 ngaphandle kokuthatha kancinci.
Kwesikhathi sakho, khetha '[Hit]' ukuthatha kadi nyingine noma '[Stand]' ukugcina.
J/Q/K = 10 iphoyinti; A = 11 noma 1, eyiphi ingcono.
